8015.title: Explicit reuse selection omits environment validation
8015.rootCauseOneLine: Only seeded reuse targets receive direct environment lookup; explicit selections are rejected when absent from sidebar threads.
8015.proposedFix: Resolve explicit reuse targets using the existing environment lookup and wait for validation before settling selection.
8015.caveats: Component-level reproduction in two clean checkouts; no live browser, reporter plugin, or older packaged release was exercised.
